title: Transcriptional Circuitry in HGSOC: A Dynamic Three-State Model Informed by a Living Biobank of Purified Tumour Fractions
authors: Barnes BM; Littler S; Tighe A; Evans A; Altringham J; Nelson L; Lin I; Morgan RD; McGrail JC; Taylor SS
one_liner_zh: 该文利用纯化肿瘤细胞活体生物库和NMF聚类定义HGSOC转录亚型，聚焦肿瘤细胞内在状态动态，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、TF-DNA结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: High-grade serous ovarian cancer (HGSOC) is a heterogeneous disease, but efforts to define transcriptional subtypes using bulk RNA sequencing have been confounded by the presence of non-malignant cells. As a result, it remains unclear whether tumour-cell-intrinsic states exist, and whether these represent stable disease subtypes or are dynamically remodelled during disease progression and treatment. Here, we address this question using a living biobank of patient-derived ovarian cancer models (OCMs) cultured as purified tumour-cell populations under uniform conditions. RNA sequencing followed by unsupervised non-negative matrix factorisation (NMF) revealed a robust, hierarchical architecture comprising three core tumour-cell-intrinsic subtypes: the Alpha cluster, marked by cell-cycle deregulation and E2F-driven replication stress; the Beta cluster, defined by tumour-cell-intrinsic immune mimicry and inflammatory signalling; and the Gamma cluster, characterised by epithelial identity, extracellular matrix engagement, and metabolic adaptation. At higher clustering resolution, a fourth cluster, Delta , emerged as a Gamma sub-lineage distinguished by a vesicle-oriented, neuronal-like secretory programme. By projecting cluster labels onto a subset of matched longitudinal OCMs using non-negative least squares, we show that while some tumours retain stable subtype identities, others display transcriptional plasticity, including transitions from epithelial-like Gamma states to more proliferative or secretory phenotypes. Together, these findings define the core architecture and dynamic potential of tumour-cell-intrinsic transcriptional states within HGSOC, thereby bridging legacy bulk classifications with emerging single-cell insights, establishing a framework for more precise patient stratification.
abstract_zh: 高级别浆液性卵巢癌（HGSOC）是一种异质性疾病，但利用批量RNA测序定义转录亚型的努力，因非恶性细胞的存在而受到干扰。因此，尚不清楚是否存在肿瘤细胞内在状态，以及这些状态是代表稳定的疾病亚型，还是在疾病进展和治疗过程中被动态重塑。在本研究中，我们利用一个由患者来源的卵巢癌模型（OCMs）组成的活体生物库，在统一条件下培养为纯化的肿瘤细胞群体，来解决这一问题。RNA测序结合无监督非负矩阵分解（NMF）揭示了一个稳健的层级结构，包含三个核心肿瘤细胞内在亚型：Alpha簇，以细胞周期失调和E2F驱动的复制应激为特征；Beta簇，以肿瘤细胞内在免疫模拟和炎症信号传导为特征；以及Gamma簇，以上皮特性、细胞外基质相互作用和代谢适应为特征。在更高聚类分辨率下，第四个簇Delta作为Gamma亚谱系出现，以囊泡导向的神经元样分泌程序为特征。通过将簇标签投影到匹配的纵向OCMs子集上，使用非负最小二乘法，我们表明，虽然一些肿瘤保持稳定的亚型身份，但其他肿瘤显示出转录可塑性，包括从上皮样Gamma状态向更具增殖性或分泌性表型的转变。总之，这些发现定义了HGSOC内肿瘤细胞内在转录状态的核心架构和动态潜力，从而弥合了传统批量分类与新兴单细胞见解之间的差距，为更精确的患者分层建立了框架。
